event.description: Richmond Ballet presents Peter and the Wolf featuring the Richmond Ballet Studio Company and Trainees Peter and the Wolf Choreography by Ma Cong Music by Sergei Prokofiev Narration by Daphne Maxwell Reid Introduce the next generation to the joy of ballet with Peter and the Wolf, a beloved classic reimagined and expanded by Richmond Ballet Artistic Director Ma Cong. Follow Peter and his animal friends on a thrilling adventure to outsmart a mischievous wolf and discover that courage and teamwork can overcome even the greatest challenges. Unique to this production is a prologue filled with even more fairytale characters, including the Three Little Pigs and Little Red Riding Hood. This family ballet, created for children and designed to appeal to audiences of all ages, is an engaging 45-minute performance that combines expressive choreography, narration, and moments of audience interaction. Featuring all-new costumes and sets by internationally acclaimed and award-winning designers, Peter and the Wolf offers a magical first ballet experience and a memorable adventure for the whole family. event.title: Bo Johnson
event.description: Stand-up comedian Bo Johnson (Comedy Central, Don't Tell Comedy) comes to Coalition Theater! Bo Johnson is a comedian from Seattle, Washington. He can be found headlining clubs, breweries, and appropriately sized theaters across the United States and Canada. His stand up has been featured on Netflix is a Joke Radio, season two of Kevin Hart Presents: Hart of the City on Comedy Central, Don’t Tell Comedy Secret Sets (twice), Hulu, & LOL Live! at the prestigious Just For Laughs comedy festival in Montreal. He was a finalist in the 39th annual Seattle International Comedy Competition and is a regular at festivals including Bumbershoot, SF Sketchfest, the Double Down Comedy Experience sponsored by Zappos, Life is Beautiful in Las Vegas, Rifflandia in Victoria BC, Prizefest, and Big Pine Comedy Festival in Phoenix. Bo has opened for major acts including Marc Maron, Joe Dombrowski, Jessica Kirson, and David Nihill. With a growing online audience Bo’s jokes have been viewed millions of times online. Most recently he released his first full length special, “Two Sailboats” in 2025. Deadline included Bo in their Future of Funny list and regarding his special wrote, “For my money, Bo Johnson had one of the best debut specials in recent memory in Two Sailboats, a self-released hour culminating in a joke performed by his father…”

event.title: Richmond Famous with Leslie and The Dots
event.description: Live comedy. True Stories. Completely unscripted. Richmond Famous is the city’s premier storytelling and improv show, featuring an all-star cast of Coalition performers and your favorite Richmond celebrities. Each month we welcome a new Richmond-area citizen as our featured guest. The guests share true stories from their lives, which the cast use as inspiration to create a hilarious comedy show right before your eyes! Joining us this month is Leslie Lilburn of Leslie and the Dots! Leslie is a Northside singer-songwriter who grew up in scenic Front Royal, VA and moved to Richmond in 2021. Leslie's musical fingerprint bears traces of a unique combination of inspirations, including the British Invasion and Country music of the 60's/70's. The result is an assortment of songs infused with joy, beauty, and heartbreak that would be at home in a Tarantino film score. He passes his time in a well-appointed garage studio, Murphy’s Pocket, with his band, The Dots. Leslie and The Dots released their debut, self-titled album on March 19, 2026. You can catch them playing all around the Richmond area. Among other events, Leslie and The Dots have been featured in the Shockoe Sessions Live and Bellwether Garage concert series. Cast: Josh Blubaugh, Jess Brooks, Chandler Brooks, Hannah Clark, Laurel George, Purnam Jantrania, Matt Micou, David Pijor, Katie Samuelsen, Kathryn Schmidt Producer and Host: Nate Shepherd Graphic Design: Eric Gordon

event.title: From The Top: An Improvised Musical
event.description: A completely improvised musical where every lyric, every note, and every dramatic plot twist is made up on the spot - just for you. From The Top is a completely improvised musical where every lyric, every note, and every dramatic plot twist is made up on the spot—just for you. Now with a regular monthly slot - every second Friday of the month at 9pm! Armed with nothing but a single audience suggestion and sheer confidence, our cast will create a brand-new musical from scratch. Will it be a sweeping romance? A high-stakes adventure? A deeply emotional ballad about a sentient loaf of bread? Only one way to find out. 🎭 No script. No score. Just pure musical chaos. 🎭 Come witness the birth (and probably dramatic death) of a musical that will never exist again. From The Top—because we don’t even know what’s coming next. CAST: Preston Bradsher Liz Davenport Jonathan Fuller Casey Searles Adam Stackhouse Adrienne Thompson Josh Wright COACHES: Preston Bradsher Josh Blubaugh

event.title: The Saturday Matinee
event.description: The Saturday Matinee is a monthly improv comedy show featuring your favorite local performers and comedy at a reasonable hour. Come catch a show before dinner and be home in your favorite PJs by bedtime! Each Matinee features long form improv comedy from two ensembles: one preexisting Richmond improv team and one Team from a Hat, made up of a selection of improvisers chosen at random at the previous month’s show. What is long form improv, you ask? Good question! It is theater that is entirely made up on the spot. To your eyes, it will feel like a short play or sketch show. You may even wonder, at times, if the performers are using ideas they came up with beforehand and practiced together. But trust us, none of it is pre-planned. Come witness the magic. Show Time: 5:30 p.m. Entry Fee: Pay What You Wish October Team from a Hat Cast: Fig, Stephen Haselhorst, Wyatt Johnson, Adam Royster, Madeline Smith, Rogue Syrena, Shelby Ware, Alexandra Williams October Team from a Hat Coach: Nate Shepherd October Featured Team: Ryan Dondero & Friends! Team from a Hat – Rules for Entry · Are you an improviser who would like to be on next month’s Team from a Hat? Signing up is easy! All you have to do is come to the Saturday Matinee and throw your name in the Hat. At the end of the show, we will draw eight names to join forces and become next month’s Team from a Hat. · To sign up for a Team from a Hat, you must have completed the basic improv curriculum at any comedy theater. For example, if you trained at Coalition, you must have completed the classes through level 401. No other experience is required. · Each Team from a Hat is provided a dedicated coach for the month and will have three rehearsals together leading up to that month’s show. Rehearsals will be on Mondays at 7:00 to 9:00 p.m. · Members of the current month’s Team from a Hat must wait one month (i.e., to the next show) to put their name back in the Hat. · NOVEMBER INFO: The next show will be November 14. The coach will be Josh Wright. Team from a Hat rehearsals will be October 26, November 2, and November 9. Questions about the show? Email nate@nateshepherd.com. Producer: Nate Shepherd Graphic Design: Eric Gordon Art: Sterling Frost

Credits include: Second City, iO, Annoyance, ComedySportz, WIT. Featuring the captivating Wheel of Forms! Cast: Patrick Gantz, Barry Hite, Nick Leveski, Matt Micou, David Pijor Graphics Design by Eric Gordon

event.description: Moving Art Two: Elevation October 22-November 1, 2026 at the Virginia Museum of Fine Arts Moving Art Two: Elevation welcomes audiences into a world of contemporary ballet designed to stir the senses and elevate the unexpected. Ode Choreography by Katarzyna Kozielska Music by Various Artists Melodia Choreography by Ma Cong Music by Lhasa de Sela COLORFORMS Choreography by Myles Thatcher Music by Steve Reich Ode is a breathtaking exploration of kinetic energy, space, and human connection by Katarzyna Kozielska. A prominent voice in contemporary European ballet, Kozielska has created works for leading companies including Tulsa Ballet, Czech National Ballet, and Chemnitz Ballet. Shaped by her long career with Stuttgart Ballet both on and off the stage, Kozielska’s distinctive choreography unfolds through expansive movement and expressive lyricism. Artistic Director Ma Cong brings Melodia, an evocative work inspired by the music of acclaimed singer Lhasa de Sela, to Richmond Ballet. This 2007 creation harnesses the passion of the human voice to capture the profound beauty of shared experiences. Classical technique meets a vibrant, modern landscape of shifting geometry in COLORFORMS by celebrated San Francisco Ballet soloist Myles Thatcher. This sought-after creator, whose work has been commissioned by renowned companies including New York City Ballet, Joffrey Ballet, and Scottish Ballet, transforms movement into a living work of art in this visually striking ballet. Dates & Times Thursday, October 22 – 6:30 PM (Opening Night) Friday, October 23 – 6:30 PM Sunday, October 25 – 1:30 PM Thursday, October 29 – 6:30 PM Friday, October 30 – 6:30 PM Sunday, November 1 – 1:30 PM Tickets start at $31*. Visit etix.com or call the Richmond Ballet Box Office at 804.344.0906 x224 open M-F from 11:00am-6:00pm. Opening Night Attend opening night of our Moving Art productions and receive exclusive access to a post show Q&A session and reception with guest choreographers and the professional dancers of Richmond Ballet. This is a unique opportunity to enjoy beer, wine, and hors d’oeuvres and mingle with our incredible team of artists. Opening night tickets, which start at $61*, reflect the added benefits. The cocktail hour at the post-show artist reception for Moving Art Two is sponsored by Dominion Energy. *this price includes facility and online convenience fees

event.title: Tchaikovsky: The Man Behind the Music
event.description: Tchaikovsky: The Man Behind the Music February 12-14, 2027 with Richmond Symphony at Dominion Energy Center Choreography by Ma Cong Music by Peter Ilyich Tchaikovsky Additional music by Alexander Glazunov, Mikhail Glinka and Fritz Kreisler Behind one of the world’s most legendary composers lies a soul, a secret, and a story waiting to be told. Tchaikovsky: The Man Behind the Music is a sweeping full-length ballet by Ma Cong that explores the life and artistry of Peter Ilyich Tchaikovsky and the relationships that shaped him. With powerful choreography and profound emotional depth, this production reveals the tension between Tchaikovsky’s public success and private turmoil, providing a rare glimpse into the heart of ballet’s most renowned composer. Dates & Times Friday, February 12 – 7:00 PM Saturday, February 13 – 2:00 PM and 7:00 PM Sunday, February 14 – 2:00 PM Tickets start at $33.60*. Visit etix.com or call the Richmond Ballet Box Office at 804.344.0906 x224 open M-F from 11:00am-6:00pm. *this price includes facility and online convenience fees

event.description: Moving Art Four: Director’s Choice May 13-23, 2027 at the Virginia Museum of Fine Arts Refined elegance and raw power take the stage in Moving Art Four: Director’s Choice. The Leaves are Fading Choreography by Antony Tudor Music by Antonín Dvořák Gnawa Choreography by Nacho Duato Music by Various Artists The Leaves are Fading is a reflection on memory, love, and the passage of time set to the lush music of Antonín Dvořák. The elegant choreography of Antony Tudor — a pioneering British choreographer who revolutionized 20th century ballet — weaves together fleeting moments of romance in this poignant masterwork. Featuring the rich music of North Africa and the Mediterranean, Gnawa pulses with rhythmic energy and spiritual intensity. Spanish visionary and global icon Nacho Duato blends athletic contemporary movement with earthy sensuality to create a mesmerizing work that celebrates the universal power of music and dance.
